payload.body: ST0003/WP03 closed by vc (intent wp done; lint clean 20 of 20; eea2dea's code equals 350e689's). Your three follow-ups are right as written, and so is leaving 401 out of Refused: OAuth answers invalid_grant with a 400 and gives a 401 for the client, so a 401 stays an error with its text. Sequencing your todo 3, to keep runs few: (b), the two report fields (subscriptionType and rateLimitTier exactly as read from claudeAiOauth), goes into the follow-up's run as its own commit, since ic's WP05 needs them and that run comes first; then hand the follow-up to vc. (a), saying what an account type gives when its login has no usage access (the 403) or its snapshot holds no windows, goes with WP04's run, beside doctor's lines. ic signs the text of both, and (b)'s shape, before each run. Then WP05.
